name: Kamikura Chisa
source:
The sole daughter of a distinguished family. Her family lineage may be well known, but they are currently experiencing financial hardships. Because of that, she accepted the marriage arranged by her parents to protect their family. 

Before her marriage, she didn't have any experience dating anyone. She first met her husband at their wedding itself, but even so, their relationship is satisfactory.

Their respective families are doing just fine.

Has a very quiet and docile personality, but holds a strong heart. She will make sure to finish anything she started. 

Her husband is acquainted with Souma's father through their business transactions.

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/yobai4/chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
